name: Cave Troll
description: A hulking grey-skinned creature with long arms, cracked tusks and scarred shoulders.

name: Giant Spider
description: A horse-sized spider with hooked legs, pale eyes and strands of sticky web clinging to its abdomen.

details.behaviour: Waits above narrow passages and attacks isolated targets.

name: Pressure-Plate Spike Trap
description: A slightly sunken stone tile hides a mechanical pressure plate.

details.activation: Stepping on the plate releases spikes from concealed wall slots.
detection: Scratches around the suspicious floor tile
disarm: Jam the plate before applying weight
details.effect: Metal spikes shoot across the corridor and can seriously injure anyone in their path.

name: Healing Potion
description: A thumb-sized glass vial filled with luminous red liquid and sealed with wax.

name: Bronze Tower Key
description: A heavy bronze key with a circular head bearing a worn tower crest.

name: Security Drone
description: A compact hovering drone with an armoured shell and rotating optical sensor.

details.behaviour: Challenges unidentified personnel and calls reinforcements when threatened.

name: Alien Parasite
description: A translucent many-limbed organism that clings to warm machinery and reacts to movement.

details.behaviour: Hides in vents and attacks isolated living targets.

name: Laser Tripwire
description: A near-invisible beam crosses a doorway between two recessed emitters.

details.activation: Breaking the beam triggers the linked security response.
details.effect: Triggers an alarm, sealed bulkheads, or an automated defence system.

name: Reactor Coolant Leak
description: White coolant vapour pours from a ruptured conduit while warning lights flash across the engineering deck.

details.activation: Entering or disturbing the damaged engineering section exposes the crew to the leak.
details.effect: Extreme cold, visibility loss and possible reactor instability.

name: Emergency Medkit
description: A white hard-shell case marked with a medical symbol and secured by a simple latch.

details.function: Contains supplies for treating trauma and stabilising injuries.

name: Shadow Figure
description: A human-shaped absence of light that appears at the edge of vision and vanishes when directly confronted.

details.behaviour: Observes from a distance before approaching isolated characters.

name: Rotten Floor Collapse
description: Water-damaged floorboards bow under weight and conceal a dark drop below.

details.activation: Crossing the weakened section causes the boards to give way.
details.effect: A character can fall into the room or cellar below and become separated from the group.
